scientific_integrity: Direct equivariant integral chain presentation, complete parity analysis and reproducible finite consistency checks. No claim of independent audit, authorship or certification.
scientific_limitations: Coinvariants are not quotient-space homology; the full integral representation and layer interchange are not determined. Nonequivariant homotopy classification is prior work. Residual risk of unindexed equivalent results; computational checks are finite and do not replace the universal proof.
title: A parity law for integral symmetry coinvariants of complete-bipartite higher independence complexes
